datasets.name: ds_coverage_status
queryLines: WITH bounds AS (SELECT MAX(trip_date) AS latest_date FROM nyc_taxi.gold.trip_summary) SELECT pickup_borough, pickup_zone, COUNT(*) AS monthly_trips, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) < 20 THEN 'UNDERSERVED' WHEN COUNT(*) BETWEEN 50 AND 200 THEN 'ADEQUATE' ELSE 'WELL_SERVICED' END AS coverage_status FROM nyc_taxi.gold.trip_summary CROSS JOIN bounds WHERE trip_date BETWEEN latest_date - INTERVAL 29 DAYS AND latest_date  GROUP BY pickup_borough, pickup_zone ORDER BY monthly_trips ASC

datasets.name: ds_service_quality
queryLines: WITH bounds AS (SELECT MAX(trip_date) AS latest_date FROM nyc_taxi.gold.trip_summary) SELECT pickup_borough, ROUND(AVG(trip_duration_minutes), 2) AS avg_duration_min, ROUND(AVG(trip_distance), 2) AS avg_distance_mi, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY trip_duration_minutes), 2) AS p95_duration_min FROM nyc_taxi.gold.trip_summary CROSS JOIN bounds WHERE trip_date BETWEEN latest_date - INTERVAL 29 DAYS AND latest_date GROUP BY pickup_borough ORDER BY avg_duration_min DESC

datasets.name: ds_service_gap
queryLines: WITH bounds AS (SELECT MAX(trip_date) AS latest_date FROM nyc_taxi.gold.trip_summary), coverage AS (SELECT pickup_zone, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) < 50 THEN 'UNDERSERVED' ELSE 'ADEQUATE' END AS coverage_status FROM nyc_taxi.gold.trip_summary CROSS JOIN bounds WHERE trip_date BETWEEN latest_date - INTERVAL 29 DAYS AND latest_date GROUP BY pickup_zone) SELECT is_weekend, pickup_borough, COUNT(DISTINCT pickup_zone) AS zones_with_service, AVG(CASE WHEN coverage.coverage_status = 'UNDERSERVED' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS pct_underserved FROM nyc_taxi.gold.trip_summary LEFT JOIN coverage USING (pickup_zone) CROSS JOIN bounds WHERE trip_date BETWEEN latest_date - INTERVAL 29 DAYS AND latest_date GROUP BY is_weekend, pickup_borough ORDER BY is_weekend, pct_underserved DESC
